parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of dash offset not working for patch objects, but it removes code that may have been intentional for backward compatibility or other reasons.

issues.description: Removing the code that sets the dash offset to 0 may introduce a behavioral regression risk, as it changes the default behavior of patch objects.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the dash offset works correctly for patch objects, which is crucial for ensuring the fix is robust.
The change is minimal, but the removal of the comment explaining the traditional behavior of patch objects may reduce maintainability.
